soldier: The head yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown and slightly tinged with smoky, pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered rather long hairs, the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows from the tip to the base. Head nearly oval, widest slightly behind the middle; labrum lanceolate. The left mandible with three marginal teeth, the right finely serrate behind the middle; the base of each mandible with a small pointed projection. Postmentum much raised, its length about 1.5 times its width. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second about twice the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the sides broadly rounded, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
